en.miui_info_text: Download and flash MIUI/HyperOS firmware for Xiaomi devices
en.miui_help_text: Click "Open download page" — this opens miuirom.org where you can pick a version (MIUI/HyperOS, Stable/Beta). Download the fastboot build (.tgz/.zip), extract it, then use the flash section below.
en.miui_select_folder_title: Select the folder with the extracted firmware
en.miui_no_folder_msg: Please select the folder with the extracted MIUI/HyperOS firmware first.

en.miui_flash_help_text: Device must be in FASTBOOT mode. The app will flash every .img file from the selected folder via `fastboot flash <filename>`. The filename without extension must match a partition name (boot, system, vendor, vbmeta, dtbo, etc.).
en.miui_platform_tools_browse_title: Select the platform-tools folder (containing adb.exe and fastboot.exe)
en.miui_platform_tools_help_text: Pick the folder containing adb and fastboot (usually the extracted Google platform-tools zip). Xiaomi firmware ships flash_all.bat/.sh but does NOT bundle adb/fastboot — on a fresh Windows machine the .bat scripts fail with "'fastboot' is not recognized". The path you set here is prepended to PATH before running the script.

en.miui_platform_tools_not_detected: Warning: adb/fastboot not found in the selected folder. Flash scripts may not work.

en.miui_no_script_msg: The selected mode requires a flash_all_{mode}.* script in the folder, but it wasn't found. Pick another mode or Manual.

Continue?
